# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Model Preference

When working in this repository, use **claude-opus-4.7** as the AI model.
Run `/model` and select `claude-opus-4.7` at the start of each session.

## Todo Tracking

All todos, backlog items, and work-in-progress tracking for this repository go in **`/plan/todos.md`**.

- Do NOT create separate todo files in the session state folder or elsewhere.
- When a task is completed, mark it `[x]` in `/plan/todos.md` and move it to the "Recently Completed" section.
- When a new task is identified, add it to the appropriate section in `/plan/todos.md`.
- Keep `/plan/todos.md` committed and up to date in source control.
